segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ חֲמִשָּׁה חוּמְשִׁין הֵן, אֵלּוּ הֵן: הָאוֹכֵל תְּרוּמָה, וּתְרוּמַת מַעֲשֵׂר, וּתְרוּמַת מַעֲשֵׂר שֶׁל דְּמַאי, וְהַחַלָּה, וְהַבִּכּוּרִים – מוֹסִיף חוֹמֶשׁ. וְהַפּוֹדֶה נֶטַע רְבָעִי וּמַעֲשֵׂר שֵׁנִי שֶׁלּוֹ – מוֹסִיף חוֹמֶשׁ. הַפּוֹדֶה אֶת הֶקְדֵּשׁוֹ – מוֹסִיף חוֹמֶשׁ. הַנֶּהֱנֶה שָׁוֶה פְּרוּטָה מִן הַהֶקְדֵּשׁ – מוֹסִיף חוֹמֶשׁ. וְהַגּוֹזֵל אֶת חֲבֵירוֹ שָׁוֶה פְּרוּטָה וְנִשְׁבַּע לוֹ – מוֹסִיף חוֹמֶשׁ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In this mishna, as in the previous one, the tanna enumerates several halakhot that share a common element. «There are five» halakhic situations where «one-fifth» is added to the value of the principal, and «these are they:» A non-priest «who eats» either «teruma, or teruma of the tithe,» which the Levite separates from the first tithe and gives to a priest, «or teruma of the tithe of demai, or ḥalla, or first fruits;» in each of these cases, «he adds one-fifth» when paying restitution to the priest who owned the produce. «And one who redeems his» own fruit of «a fourth-year sapling or second-tithe» produce «adds one-fifth. One who redeems his» own «consecrated» property «adds one-fifth. One who derives benefit worth one peruta from consecrated» property «adds one-fifth. And one who robs the value of one peruta from another and takes» a false «oath» in response «to his» claim «adds one-fifth» when paying restitution.

moves.summary: Mishna lists five cases of adding one-fifth.

positions.claim: one adds a fifth for eating teruma-type gifts, redeeming one's own fourth-year fruit, second tithe or consecrated property, benefiting from consecrated property, and robbery with a false oath
